title: UserRefreshTokensResponse
description: Paginated list of user's active refresh tokens

refresh_tokens.description: List of active refresh tokens for the current page

total_count.description: Total number of active refresh tokens (across all pages)

UserRefreshTokenItem.description: A single active refresh token with device/location metadata

device_name.description: Device name associated with the token

location.description: Location when the token was created

ip.description: IP address when the token was created

created_at.description: When the refresh token was created (format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)
